items.item_text: resume

Must possess valid California Driver's License to drive a County or University vehicle. Ability and means to travel on a flexible schedule as needed, proof of liability damage insurance on vehicle used is required. Reimbursement of job-related travel will be reimbursed according to University policies.
Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field, or equivalent experience.
Strategic HR Partnership & Workforce Planning
Serve as the primary HR advisor to regional leadership, translating business strategy into workforce strategy
Partner with leadership to assess organizational needs, workforce gaps, and operational priorities
Lead or facilitate workforce planning, organizational design, and role clarity discussions
Support succession planning and organizational effectiveness initiatives
Use data and trends to inform recommendations and strategic decision-making
Identify workforce-related risks, including compliance, organizational, and employee relations risks
Ensure HR practices align with institutional policies, regulations, and contractual obligations
Monitor trends and proactively address emerging issues within the region
Serve as the integrator of HR services within the assigned region, ensuring alignment across HR functions and leadership priorities
Partner with operational and financial stakeholders (e.g., leadership, finance, program leads) to align workforce decisions with resource strategy
Promote consistency while adapting HR solutions to regional needs
HR Intake, Triage & Cross-Functional Accountability
Serve as the primary intake point (“watcher”) for all HR-related requests within the assigned region, including recruitment needs
Triage issues and determine appropriate HR functional involvement (Talent, Compensation, HR Operations, ELR)
Ensure timely follow-through, coordination, and accountability across HR functions
Monitor progress of HR actions and intervene as needed to resolve delays or misalignment
Ensure a consistent, high-quality client experience across all HR services
Classification & Talent Strategy Coordination
Evaluate and support development of position descriptions and job classifications. Engage with Compensation for titles that are new, not regularly used or at the executive levels.
Approve Position Management Forms (PMFs) within delegated authority
Partner with Talent Acquisition to align recruitment strategies with workforce needs
Recommend search committee composition to support equitable and effective hiring practices
Provide input into Recruiters’ performance evaluations based on regional partnership, service quality, and outcomes
Does not execute recruitment logistics; focuses on strategy, alignment, and oversight
Employee & Labor Relations Coordination & Advisory
Partner closely with the Employee & Labor Relations (ELR) team to coordinate handling of employee relations matters
Serve as an initial advisor to leadership on emerging workplace concerns, helping to assess when issues may require ELR involvement
Provide guidance to managers on appropriate early intervention, communication strategies, and conflict navigation during routine check-ins
Support leaders in recognizing potential risks and identifying when to escalate issues to ELR for formal review or intervention
Facilitate communication and alignment between leadership and ELR to ensure consistent understanding of issues and next steps
Reinforce consistent application of policies and practices by directing leaders to appropriate ELR resources and expertise
Monitor trends and recurring concerns within the region and coordinate with ELR to proactively address systemic issues
7+ years of progressively responsible HR experience, including strategic advisory work.
Demonstrated experience advising senior or executive leadership.
Strong knowledge of employee and labor relations principles and HR practices.
Experience supporting complex or multi-unit organizations.
Excellent communication, consultation, and problem-solving skills.
Skill in listening, negotiating, and adapting communication style to different audiences.
Experience working cooperatively with individuals representing a wide range of perspectives and functions.
Experience within a public sector or higher education environment.
Familiarity with UC policies, including PPSM, APM, and Career Tracks.
Experience supporting both staff and academic personnel.
HR certification (e.g., SPHR, SHRM-SCP).

As of January 1, 2014, ANR is a smoke- and tobacco-free environment in which smoking, the use of smokeless tobacco products, and the use of unregulated nicotine products (e-cigarettes), is strictly prohibited.
